dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual symmetric tapering visible from the mid-section toward the anterior head and narrowing toward the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Smooth lateral margins with no discernible localized bulges or indentations where the skin meets the water.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light grey to off-white median tone across the visible dorsal area.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Subtle, low-density grey mottling observed around the blowhole and across the anterior dorsal region.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse transitions between pigmented areas and the primary light-grey surface.
